HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Certificate of Incorporation of Harbor Labs, Inc., with Certificate of Conversion
Filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on June 2, 2011.
The company converts from Harbor Labs, LLC, a Colorado limited liability company
formed February 8, 2011.
Authorized stock: 5,000,000 shares of common stock, par value $0.0001 per share.
Delaware registered agent: First Example Agents, Inc., 300 Demo Road, Sample Town,
Delaware.
Incorporator: Jane Doe.
Under the plan of conversion the LLC units are cancelled, and each member then buys
founder stock under a stock agreement.
